name: jev
description: Jev-powered model routing for Codex: classify each prompt and hand simple work to cheaper models (Luna/Sol), escalating hard work to Astra.

interface.shortDescription: Route each prompt to the cheapest capable model
interface.longDescription: jev classifies every prompt with TypeSafe's Jev (~130 ms) and routes it: simple work goes to cheaper models, hard work escalates, and pushback automatically moves the task back up. Three stages trade savings against caution.
defaultPrompt: Why did jev route my last prompt that way?
